review_question: Can the existing governed acquisition layer produce selector-safe, source-grounded evidence for Health indemnity product class, base-product status and retail individual/family-floater availability without exposing raw semantic-bearing content or weakening the blindness boundary?
verdict_summary: The existing governed identity/currentness acquisition layer cannot prove the complete frozen Health product-eligibility predicate using only current selector-safe contracts. A prospective generic product-eligibility evidence projection is required before another neutral Health experiment.

current_contracts_can_prove: exact insurer-scoped product identity when explicit product name evidence is present
exact UIN identity when explicit UIN evidence is present
explicit currentness status and product/UIN binding when present in authorized metadata artifacts
current_contracts_cannot_prove: base product versus rider or add-on status
evidence.source_asset_classifier_reason: SourceAssetClassifier page_intent and asset_scope are URL/title routing classifications and do not constitute source-grounded proof of Health indemnity class, base-product status or retail purchase mode.
evidence.product_signal_extractor_reason: ProductSignalExtractor contains semantic-bearing sections such as riders_or_addons and derives product naming from URL/title/section heuristics. Those raw signals are not authorized to cross the blind selector boundary and therefore cannot fill the missing eligibility fields in Product #13.
evidence.identity_currentness_acquirer_reason: The acquisition layer correctly performs bounded machine-side traversal and emits raw-location-free identity/currentness projections, but its output schema has no governed product-class, base/rider or retail purchase-mode evidence fields.

prospective_repair_shape.position_in_pipeline: inside governed metadata acquisition after authorized artifact capture and before neutral selector eligibility evaluation
prospective_repair_shape.selection_requires: health_indemnity + base_product + retail_available + at least one of individual/family_floater, bound to the same exact product/UIN evidence without ambiguity

next_step: After this fitness verdict merges green, implement and test the prospective generic product-eligibility evidence projection, then freeze that repair before any Product #14 preregistration.
